repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVdP6nEyftgTJapu6J

## 维护者速读
字段区改成一列、三处共用、关联记录变色块、空字段收到最后一行、「系统信息」替代底部那行小字、单击可编辑字段直接改，这些代码都按卡和裁决做了，写法干净。但这一轮还不能过，原因有四个：① 一个手机触控尺寸的自动化测试会因为铅笔按钮的写法变了而直接报错，CI 的 E2E 会红；② 裁决说手机上不显示复制图标，现在手机上点一下只读值，复制图标还会冒出来；③ 卡上要求的几张截图还缺（深色、预览拉宽到 900、分组折叠、空字段那一行），而且要贴到 PR 上；④ 只有对象声明了「可折叠」的分组才有右侧箭头，CRM 的分组默认不可折叠所以看不到箭头，这个理解要写进 PR 正文。另有一件要席位安排：裁决要求在真手机上确认长按能选中文字，线程没有真机。
L1 结论：退回补改（REWORK），都是小改，不涉及方向。

## 席位核对 — REWORK (L1-d) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `45810417` · 2026-11-22T03:06Z

**Face:** UI only (`plugin-detail`, `fields`, `i18n`, tests). `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (`ReferenceChipContext` + 5 i18n keys per pack), `Metadata-protocol: none`; no `packages/spec/src/**`, no `docs/adr/**`. 27 files, +1050 / −44, under 3,000. `RecordDetailView.tsx` untouched; overlap-watch files touched: `RecordPageColumns.tsx` only, inside the card's region. `l1-face`: clean apart from checks still running (read at 7 success / 13 skip / 16 pending).

### Read against card #36147 and ruling 7066516044, item by item
- **1, 2, 8 one list, one column.** `RecordPageColumns` sets `DetailsColumnCapContext` to 1 unless `fullPage && otherTabs.length === 0 && resolved.hidden.length === 0` (the card's #35890 item-4 exception), and the phone's grouped-inset branch is skipped on the frameless face. Shots: drawer 707/720 one column, phone 375 the same rows, opportunity full page 3 → 1 (it has other tabs, so per the card's 「不管容器多宽」). ✔ in code.
- **3 group row.** Chevron moved to the row's right end, down folded / up open, whole row toggles. ⚠ see M3: only groups the object declares foldable get it.
- **4 chips (ruling 6).** `ReferencedRecordLink` under `ReferenceChipContext` draws `ObjectIconTile` (object `color` / `icon`) + full name, `break-words`; same anchor, same `openRecord`; no route → plain pill. `clickBelongsElsewhere` hands a click on the chip to the link, the rest of an editable lookup's row edits (#36015 precedent). ✔
- **5 empty fields (ruling 4).** `recordFieldList.ts` tally (`useId` + layout effect, `useSyncExternalStore`), one `EmptyFieldsRow`, choice = per-object `showEmptyFields` (#25883), authored `hideEmpty` neither shown nor counted, reporting withdrawn while editing. Replaces the ratio rule and 「N 个空分组」 only under the field list; `DetailView`'s own fold is skipped there. ✔
- **6 系统信息 (ruling 5).** `RecordMetaFooter` draws a read-only, `defaultCollapsed` `DetailSection` (created by/on, updated by/on when updated, owner only by the #28868/#35941 rule, record ID) under the field list, wrapped in `RecordPageProvenanceContext false` so its rows report no body field. The objectui#12307 line stays everywhere else. ✔ (it reverses #12307 on this page exactly as ruled).
- **7 click to edit (rulings 1–3).** Single click on an editable value → `onEnterInlineEdit`; double-click unwired on the frameless face; read-only rows lose click-to-copy (`copyInteractive … && !frameless`); pencil kept `sr-only` + `focus-visible` for keyboard. ✔ desktop; ⚠ phone, see M2.
- Changeset: every sentence read against the code above; true.

### Must fix
- **M1 — E2E UI will go red.** `ui/e2e/record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts:89` reads the pencil's class with `/className="([^"]+)"\s*aria-label=\{t\('detail\.editInlineHint'\)\}/` from `DetailSection.tsx`. On `origin/main` it matches; on `45810417` the pencil's `className={frameless ? … : …}` matches nothing (checked with node on both files), and `grab()` throws at module load, so the whole spec fails (it is in `ui/playwright.config.ts`'s `testDir`, not the ignored `live/`). Fix the read (the non-frameless string still carries the 44 px / `pointer-coarse` tokens), and update the spec's text: on the record page's field list a phone now enters edit by tapping the value, not through a visible pencil.
- **M2 — ruling 1, "on phone there is no copy icon".** The frameless row keeps the copy `Button` at `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 …` with no `pointer-coarse` / `sm` gate. On a touch screen a tap sets `:hover`, so the icon appears and is tappable (opacity-0 also leaves it hit-testable at rest). Hide it on a coarse pointer on the frameless face (e.g. `pointer-coarse:hidden`), and pin that in `DetailSection.fieldList-36147`.
- **M3 — item 3's reading, in the body.** The chevron and whole-row toggle draw only for a `collapsible` section; a field group's spec default is `collapse: 'none'` ("always open, no toggle", `object.zod.ts:1578`), so on CRM (both 商机 and 其他 in the shots) no group has an arrow, and only 系统信息 folds. Keeping the authored contract is the right reading (making `none` groups foldable would override metadata and would be a seat question), but the body ticks item 3 and the card's acceptance line reads "点了折叠，再点展开". Write the reading in the body's dev-thread calls, and show a declared-foldable group folded and open in the evidence.
- **M4 — evidence owed (brief + card acceptance).** (a) dark mode for the drawer, the pinned column and the phone (the brief requires light and dark); (b) the drawer dragged to 900 still one column (card acceptance, line 1); (c) the drawer's bottom: the 「显示 N 个空字段」 row folded and opened, and 系统信息 opened, in the drawer and on the phone (only the pinned column's opened shot exists); (d) the before / after shots on the PR itself, as an evidence comment (the card asks for them in the PR; the project folder is not on GitHub).

### For the seat (not the thread's to close)
- Ruling 1 asks the thread to check on a device that long-press selects a read-only value. The thread reports `user-select: auto` with no click or touch handler, emulation only. **NOT MEASURED** on hardware; the seat decides whether a real-phone check (Sales's device) is owed before landing or whether the source reading suffices.

### Should fix (thread's call)
- **S1.** On the frameless face the `sr-only` pencil keeps `aria-label={t('detail.editInlineHint')}` and the same tooltip, i.e. "Double-click to edit" / 双击编辑, while the interaction is now a click or Enter. A screen reader announces the wrong gesture. Give it the field's edit name or `detail.clickToEdit` there. (`read-only-member-record.spec.ts:44` and `RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx:3032` count pencils by that name; keep them true.)

### Nits
- **N1.** The opportunity full page at 1440 goes from 3 columns to 1 in its 详情 tab because it has other tabs: that is the card's rule, and it is a visible desktop change; worth one line in 维护者速读.
- **N2.** `content/docs/ui/components/record.mdx:60` still says "double-click / pencil" for `record:details`; true for authored pages, which keep their face. No change owed.

Once M1–M4 land, I read only the delta. L1 never replaces L2: the seat's declaration L2 follows on the green head.

The drawer dragged to 900 stays one column, as the card's first acceptance line asks.

**M3, a group the object declares foldable** (showcase `showcase_semantic_zoo`, `财务信息` is `collapse: 'collapsed'`; drawer 460): folded, the title row reads `财务信息`, `aria-expanded=false`, chevron down, 2 rows drawn; after a click on the title row, `aria-expanded=true`, chevron up, 4 rows (Amount and Budget). CRM's groups declare no `collapse`, so they draw no chevron (the spec default `none`); see the body's dev-thread calls.

**Behaviour, desktop 1440 and iPhone 12 emulation:** one click or tap on 金额 opens its editor; a click or tap on the read-only 距成交天数 opens nothing; the 客户 chip's `href` is the account record. Long-press selection on a physical phone: **NOT MEASURED**, owed to the first hosted phone reading (body).

**The PNGs are not attached here.** This session has no way to upload an image to GitHub (no browser session, and the write relay carries text only), so the shots stay in the project folder, `build-seat1/36147/shots/{before,after,rework}/`, 22 rework shots plus 6 before and 7 after, with `measure.json` beside each set. ## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-d, delta) · repo:objectstack#1 · head `88f577e3` · 2026-11-22T03:29Z

**Delta from:** `45810417` (REWORK 7073339471). Rework commit `0412677d` (6 files, +98 / −31) and merge `88f577e3` (main `c30ce97c`, #36208 in). `git show --remerge-diff 88f577e3` is empty: no conflict resolved by hand.

**Gates at `88f577e3` (read while running):** 13 success, 15 skipped, 31 in progress. If this head goes green unchanged this record is final; a new head gets a delta read.

### My items
- **M1 done.** The pencil classes are module constants `PENCIL_CLASS` / `FIELD_LIST_PENCIL_CLASS`; `record-flow-phone-targets.spec.ts` reads both with token checks, and its header now says a phone enters edit by tapping the value on the field list. New case: at 375 on touch the field-list pencil measures ≤ 1×1 and grows on a keyboard `Tab` focus; the thread reports it red first (the old `w-6` beat `sr-only`'s 1 px, hence `h-px w-px`) then green, 6/6 locally. The non-field-list pencil string is byte-identical to `main`'s.
- **M2 done.** The copy button gains `pointer-coarse:hidden` on the frameless face only (`cn(…, frameless && …)`) and a `data-detail-copy` hook; `fieldList-36147` pins the class on the field list and a control pins its absence outside it.
- **M3 done.** The body's dev-thread calls state the reading (a chevron only on a group the object declares `collapse: 'collapsed' | 'expanded'`, and 系统信息; spec default `none` untouched; changing that is a seat question). Evidence: showcase `showcase_semantic_zoo` `财务信息` (`collapse: 'collapsed'`) folded (chevron down, `aria-expanded=false`) and open (chevron up, 4 rows).
- **M4 done, one part disclosed.** Evidence comment 7073553216: light and dark, drawer 460 and 900 (900 still `grid 1, 1`), the empties row folded / shown / folded again and 系统信息 open in the drawer and on the phone at 375, the pinned column at 1440; numbers per shot in `measure.json`. I read `drawer-900-bottom-open-dark.png`: one column, 系统信息 open (创建时间 / 修改时间 / 记录编号), 「隐藏空字段」 last. **The PNGs are not on GitHub**: the thread has no browser session and the relay carries text, so the PR has the per-shot table and the folder path. For the seat: attaching them needs someone with a browser; I do not hold the PR for it.
- **S1 taken.** On the field list the pencil's `aria-label`, its tooltip and the value's `title` read `detail.clickToEdit`; every other face keeps `detail.editInlineHint`. The pencil counters (`RecordDetailView.harness.test.tsx`, `read-only-member-record.spec.ts`) accept both names; the live spec's admin control moves from `toBeVisible` to a count > 0 because the field-list pencil is `sr-only` (the member half still asserts none).
- **N1 done.** 维护者速读 names the opportunity full page's 详情 going from 3 columns to 1.
- Long-press on a physical phone: **NOT MEASURED**, disclosed in the body, owed to the first hosted phone reading per the seat's call.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `de16b11f675f47e18ed03aa4d47ae1122c8d3e49`
Local-runs: none

Read at 2026-11-22T03:58:14Z. Inputs: card #36147 (body, the seat claim 7066162109, the maintainer ruling 7066516044 and every other comment), epic #35590, PR #36136, #36012 and #36042 (bodies), PR #36234 (body, file list, the L1-d rework 7073339471, the delta accepts 7073569893 and 7073583003, the evidence comment 7073553216), the net diff `origin/main...de16b11f` (30 files, +1134 / −61), and the head's check-runs: 45 success, 13 skipped, none failed or pending. Those runs answer every derived gate; nothing was built or run here.

### ① Derived judgments

Public surface and accept sets:

- `@object-ui/fields` gains `ReferenceChipContext` (`React.createContext(false)`, exported from the package entry `src/index.tsx`). Default `false`, so every existing consumer keeps the link face. Only `DetailSection`'s frameless face provides `true`. Additive, and named right in the PR body and the changeset.
- `@object-ui/i18n` gains five keys under `detail` (`systemInfo`, `createdTime`, `updatedTime`, `recordNumber`, `clickToEdit`). I checked all 11 packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant). In every pack all five keys sit inside the `detail:` block and carry real translated text, with no English left in place. zh-Hant uses the generator's output (`點選編輯`). Named right.
- `RecordFieldListContext`, `recordFieldList.ts` and `EmptyFieldsRow` are module-internal and absent from the plugin-detail barrel, as the body says. `DetailsColumnCapContext` keeps its type (`1 | 2 | 3`); only the value `RecordPageColumns` gives it changes, from `pinned ? 1 : 3` to `detailsFillPage ? 3 : 1`. No prop, export or schema key is removed. No `packages/spec` path is touched. Right.

The behaviour changes, measured against the card and ruling 7066516044:

- Every change is gated on `frameless = useDefaultRecordPage() && !isPrintPage`. That context is provided only by `RecordPageColumns` and by the two synthesized-page fallbacks in `RecordDetailView.tsx`, both set to `!assignedPage && !namedPageBlocked`. Authored record pages, print pages and every other `DetailView` (where the context defaults to false) therefore keep their face: the pencil, double-click, click-to-copy, the per-group empty toggle, the 「N 个空分组」 line and the one-line meta footer. The new controls in `DetailSection.fieldList-36147` and `RecordMetaFooter.systemInfo-36147` pin this. Right, with one unnamed fourth place (N2).
- No pencil, single-click edit: the click handler is gated on the same `canInlineEditField` that gated the old double-click and the pencil. That gate is `fieldEditable` (not readonly, not computed, not a system field, not inline-excluded, the caller's write grant) plus `onEnterInlineEdit` being threaded. A click on a link, button, control or text selection inside the value is not taken (`clickBelongsElsewhere`). The pencil stays as a `sr-only` keyboard entry. Ruling items 2 and 3. Right.
- Read-only rows no longer copy on a click (`copyInteractive` gains `!frameless`). Masked fields are still not copyable, since `copyOffered` is unchanged. Ruling item 1. Right.
- The objectui#12307 meta footer becomes 「系统信息」 only when `fieldList && v3MetaLine`. Its rows are `readonly: true`, it gets no `onEnterInlineEdit`, and it is wrapped in `RecordPageProvenanceContext false`, so the owner-once rule still reads the body alone. Outside the field list the line is unchanged. Ruling item 5. Right.
- The per-group empty toggle, the ratio rule and `EmptySectionsFold` are skipped only under the field list. The single last row uses the existing per-object `showEmptyFields` preference, and an authored `hideEmpty` group is neither shown nor counted. Ruling item 4. Right.
- No permission or edit right is widened. Single-click edit applies only where the value was already editable. On a phone, a tap reaches inline edit where it used to copy. That is a new gesture, not a new right, and ruling item 2 rules it explicitly. The 「系统信息」 rows show the same audit and owner values the meta line already drew, through the same `LookupCellRenderer` path. Right.
- The copy-icon sentence in the changeset does not match the touch behaviour the code now has. This is M1.

Findings:

- **M1 (must-fix) — the changeset misstates the touch behaviour of the copy icon.** `.changeset/36147-record-field-list.md` says "the click-to-copy on read-only rows is removed on this page (its copy icon, shown on hover or keyboard focus, stays)". Since rework commit `0412677d`, the copy button on the frameless face carries `pointer-coarse:hidden` (`DetailSection.tsx`, the `frameless && "pointer-coarse:hidden"` class). On a phone, and on any device whose main pointer is coarse, there is no copy icon, even on keyboard focus. That is exactly ruling item 1's "on phone there is no copy icon … copied by long-press text selection". The changeset was written in `d6a453d4` and never revised after the rework, so the line that becomes CHANGELOG text tells readers that phones keep a copy path the PR removes, and it omits the long-press route entirely. A published CHANGELOG line cannot be hand-edited after the release. Fix: amend the parenthesis, for example "(for a mouse or keyboard its copy icon, shown on hover or keyboard focus, stays; a touch screen shows none, and the value is selected by a long press)". This needs a delta read only.
- **N1 (nit) — the changeset's one-column list leaves out the desktop full page that has other tabs.** The first bullet lists the drawer, the split pane, the phone tab and the pinned left column.
